rules.title: fmt and validate
rules.text: Run terraform fmt and terraform validate before committing.

rules.title: Plan before apply
rules.text: Never apply without reviewing a plan; do not run apply against production from an agent.

rules.title: Modules and variables
rules.text: Use modules and typed variables with descriptions; avoid hardcoded values.

rules.title: Remote state
rules.text: Use remote state with locking and never commit state files or secrets.

rules.title: Pin providers
rules.text: Pin provider versions in required_providers and commit the .terraform.lock.hcl lock file.

rules.title: Separate environments
rules.text: Separate environments with distinct state and variable files.

rules.title: No hardcoded ids
rules.text: Reference resources and data sources rather than hardcoding IDs and ARNs.

rules.title: Mark sensitive outputs
rules.text: Mark sensitive variables and outputs as sensitive.
